TWO gaps, both small ports of existing code — NOT a rebuild:

GAP A (THE REAL ONE — the résumé path is starved, not the LinkedIn path). The résumé/cv-ingest path does NOT write experienceHighlights to root pa-users at all. Verified: the ONLY writers of pa-users.experienceHighlights are coresignal-experiences-mirror.ts:516 and (to the self-profile mirror only) identity.ts:618. cv-ingest.ts writes per-experience descriptions into parsedCandidateResumes.experiences[].description (L2251 baseDoc) but mergeUserTags only distills them to tags.workHistorySummary, which is a bare 'title @ company' list — buildWorkHistorySummary (user-tags-merger.ts:851-890) DROPS .description. So a résumé-only user has NO experienceHighlights[].description on root pa-users → the pitch's IMPACT NARRATIVE block (agent.ts:237-251, which requires .description) is EMPTY for them, even though the impact text exists in parsedCandidateResumes. To make a résumé yield the SAME pitch data as a LinkedIn login, add a projector that maps parsedCandidateResumes.experiences[] (or the cv parse output) → root pa-users.experienceHighlights[] using the SAME buildExperienceHighlightsFromRecord shape. The mapper already exists and is source-tagged ('LinkedIn'); generalize sourceLabel to 'résumé' and feed it the résumé experiences. Best seam: the [cv-parsed] trigger / mergeUserTags worker, written via the same writeBoth pattern.

GAP B (LinkedIn-login → Coresignal for an SMS-inbound onboarding user). The mirror+adapter currently only run inside the admin external-supply batch path (resolve-identity.ts off a pa-external-candidate-records create). There is no onboarding-time hook that, on a candidate LinkedIn quick-auth, (1) resolves their linkedin_url → a Coresignal employee id, (2) calls fetchEmployeeCollect for that single id, (3) normalizes via normalizeCoresignalCollectV2, (4) runs runCoresignalExperiencesMirror against the candidate's existing pa-users/{uid} (NOT a new prospect), and (5) fires the synthetic [cv-parsed] inbound so thin Claire reacts. All five pieces exist as functions; the missing glue is a single onboarding-path orchestration that calls them with the logged-in uid and merges (mergeResumeDescriptionsIntoRecord already handles the merge-with-résumé case). The LinkedIn-URL→Coresignal-id resolution step is the one genuinely new sub-piece (Coresignal search-by-linkedin-url vs the current operator-pastes-ids flow) — scope it explicitly. Note also the cv-ingest invite-gate skipLimitEnforcement fix (already deploying) is on the RÉSUMÉ branch and is unrelated to the LinkedIn/Coresignal branch.
risks: Two pitch generators exist and are easy to conflate: the ONBOARDING opener (agent.ts loadGlobalContext PART 1 + PART 2 prompt, reads experienceHighlights) vs paGeneratePitchEmail (generate-pitch-email.ts, an admin EMAIL outreach that reads userDoc.experiences + a matching-jobs job and is evidence-gated). The task's pitch is the FORMER; do not wire experienceHighlights into the latter expecting the opener to improve.

Field-source mismatch is the silent failure mode: the pitch reads experienceHighlights from the ROOT pa-users doc, but identity.ts/writeCandidateSelfProfile writes it ONLY to pa-candidate-self-profiles (the /me read-model). A LinkedIn-login flow that writes only the self-profile (not root pa-users) will leave the pitch starved — the mirror's writeBoth gets this right (writes BOTH), so reuse writeBoth, do not reinvent.

The pitch only emits a highlight if it has a .description (agent.ts:238). Coresignal sometimes returns experiences with no description; mapExperience falls back to active_experience_description only for the active/first role (coresignal-collect-v2.ts:119-122). For a profile whose top-2 roles lack descriptions, the IMPACT block is still empty → swap-test still fails. The résumé-description backfill (mergeResumeDescriptionsIntoRecord) mitigates only when a résumé is also on file.

buildExperienceHighlightsFromRecord hard-codes source:'coresignal_collect_v2'/sourceLabel:'LinkedIn'. If reused verbatim for a résumé projector (GAP A), it will mislabel résumé highlights as LinkedIn — parameterize sourceLabel.

Coresignal cost + identity: fetchEmployeeCollect is a paid per-id call and the current flow needs a candidate ID, not a linkedin_url. Resolving an arbitrary candidate LinkedIn URL→Coresignal id at onboarding time (GAP B) is the one new dependency and may not always resolve; need a graceful fall-through to the résumé path (requirement #2: SMS-only with no LinkedIn → résumé must be seamless).

Idempotency/dedup: the mirror skips when a coresignalEmployeeId already mirrored (L412-422) and only overwrites linkedinUrl when absent or an oauth marker (L493-498). Re-running at onboarding for an already-imported external prospect is safe, but a candidate who is BOTH an external prospect and an SMS inbound could collide on identity — confirm uid resolution lands on the SAME pa-users/{uid} (LinkedIn-hash index per product rule 12) before mirroring.
